data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next catch, and I’d like us to keep this lake supporting the village for years. With 100 tons in it now, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50, and let the lake replenish to 100. That’s $10,000 each, month after month, if we stick to it. I propose we agree to that limit and check our catches together each month. John, what do you think?
